About PowerCure

PowerCure develops premium Class 3B laser therapy devices designed for wellness, mobility support, recovery, healthy aging, and active lifestyles for both people and pets.

Our flagship PowerCure Pro delivers up to 1300mW of laser power, making it one of the highest-powered portable laser therapy devices available for home use. Unlike many consumer wellness devices that rely primarily on LEDs, PowerCure utilizes true Class 3B laser technology with dual wavelengths (650nm + 808nm) to deliver advanced photobiomodulation in a convenient and easy-to-use format.

What Makes Us Different

• Up to 1300mW output power
• True Class 3B laser technology
• Dual-wavelength lasers (650nm + 808nm)
• Advanced photobiomodulation technology
• Portable and easy-to-use devices
• Human wellness and pet wellness product lines
• Trusted by wellness professionals, pet owners, and home users worldwide

How Affiliates Can Earn

• Earn 15% commission on qualified sales
• 60-day cookie duration
• Exclusive affiliate discount codes
• Automatic affiliate tracking
• Monthly PayPal payouts
• High average order value and strong earning potential

Who Should Join

• Wellness professionals
• Chiropractors
• Physical therapists
• Massage therapists
• Fitness and health creators
• Veterinarians
• Pet rehabilitation specialists
• Pet influencers and content creators
• Affiliate marketers looking for premium wellness products

How to Promote PowerCure

• Product reviews and comparisons
• Wellness and recovery content
• Pet wellness content
• Educational articles and videos
• Social media content
• Email newsletters
• YouTube and influencer campaigns

Affiliate Resources

Partners receive exclusive discount codes, professional product photos, lifestyle images, videos, banners, educational content, marketing materials, and dedicated affiliate support to help maximize conversions and earnings.

PowerCure products are used in over 60 countries worldwide and are trusted by thousands of customers seeking premium laser therapy solutions.

SEM & Google Ads Policy: Affiliates are strictly prohibited from bidding on "PowerCure" branded keywords (including but not limited to "PowerCure", "PowerCure Pro", "PowerCure Laser", or "PowerCure Vet") on any search engines (Google, Bing, etc.). Direct linking to our website via paid search ads is prohibited. Any commissions generated through brand-bidding will be permanently voided and may lead to account termination.


3. Commissions, Payment, and Clearance Period

Structure: You will earn a commission amount based on the current Commission structure (e.g., 15%). Commissions are calculated based on the order value, excluding taxes and shipping costs.


45-Day Clearance Period: To account for our 30-day trial policy and shipping times, all commissions are subject to a 45-day clearance period before they become "Approved".


Payout Timing: Approved commissions are paid monthly on the 15th via PayPal.


Refunds & Chargebacks: Commissions will NOT be paid for transactions that result in refunds, chargebacks, or cancellations.


Self-Referral Prohibited: Affiliates are not allowed to earn commissions on their own orders. Any "self-buying" to gain a discount will result in the commission being voided.


4. Marketing Tools

We may share promotion media such as banners, logos, or specific collection assets through the Marketing Tool tab. You can download the media or use the HTML embed code to share on your authorized channels.


5. Network (Multi-level Marketing)

If the Network tab is activated, affiliates can invite others to become their downline affiliates. Upline affiliates will receive a network commission based on the sales of their downline, subject to our specific multi-level settings.


6. Cookie Tracking

Mechanism: We use a cookie to track clicks on your link. If a customer clears their cookies or uses a private browser that blocks tracking, we cannot pay earnings on that activity.


Duration: Our cookie duration is 60 days. Within this window, subsequent orders from the same customer will result in commissions for the affiliate.


7. Removal from Program & Termination

If an affiliate wishes to be removed, they can contact: support@powercure.com. We also reserve the right to terminate any affiliate who violates these terms (especially regarding brand bidding or fraud) without prior notice.
